name: 山君石心
text: 战斗开始时，获得3点[护甲]。
flavor: 从护山大阵阵眼里取出的一块石头，摸上去是温的。

art.subject: a fist-sized grey stone shaped like a heart with a faint mountain vein pattern glowing warm blue inside, resting on a folded dark cloth

name: 冰蚕弦
text: 每当你在应对中打出牌，获得3点[护甲]。
flavor: 冰蚕吐的丝，弹一声，寒三分。

art.subject: a coil of translucent silk string spun by an ice silkworm, glittering with frost, the small pale silkworm resting on the coil, close-up on dark wood

name: 崩山石
text: 第3回合开始时，召唤一个「山岩」（[坚守]）。
flavor: 护山大阵崩落的一角，落地便成了墙。

art.subject: a jagged fragment of a carved mountain gate stone engraved with protective runes, standing upright on cracked earth, dust around it

name: 断弦
text: 每当你在应对中打出牌，对一名随机敌人造成3点伤害。
flavor: 弦断了，音还在，只是变得锋利。

art.subject: a snapped zither string coiled in the air like a silver whip, frost crystals along its broken end, dark wood background

name: 关城钥
text: 每场战斗第一次在应对中打出牌后，抽2张牌。
flavor: 钥匙只有一把，门从来没开过。

art.subject: a huge iron fortress key with frost on its teeth, hung on a thick blue cord

name: 烽燧
text: 敌方回合开始时，获得3点[护甲]。
flavor: 烟一起，关上的人就醒了。

art.subject: a small stone beacon tower model with a curl of smoke rising from its top
